methodology_notice: 1 km screening search corridor — NOT a 2D hydrodynamic inundation boundary. Infrastructure exposure and bridge-cut isolation metrics are screening indicators for prioritization only.

dimensions.1_hazard_susceptibility_static: Published Rounce et al. (2016) GLOF hazard classes and Fujita et al. (2013) Potential Flood Volume (PFV), preserved strictly untouched from lakes_core.json.
dimensions.2_corridor_exposure_screening: Exact perpendicular point-to-segment screening inventory within a 1 km search corridor of HydroRIVERS/DEM routed channels (NOT a 2D inundation polygon).
dimensions.3_road_cut_hospital_isolation: Functional healthcare-access isolation screening identifying corridor settlements whose nearest mapped clinic/hospital lies downstream of or across impacted corridor bridges, paired with nearest mapped hospital distance and disruption tier.
dimensions.4_uncertainty_and_coverage_limits: OpenStreetMap coverage in rural Himalayan valleys is incomplete (lower bound). Distances are straight-line geodesic km rather than road-network travel time, and bridge hydraulic scour/deck clearance is not modelled.

uncertainty_and_coverage_limits.osm_completeness_caveat: OSM settlements, clinics, hospitals, bridges, and hydropower MW tags are lower bounds; absence of mapped facilities does not imply absence on the ground.
